LimitationStatement: Optimization prediction errors reached 4.1133 dB in the tested cases.
The High case produced -0.5866 dB SPICE improvement despite a predicted improvement of +3.8906 dB.
Optimization was evaluated using Low, Medium and High representative cases rather than exhaustive optimization of the complete design space.
The validated dataset and experiments concern a Common-Emitter BJT amplifier and should not automatically be generalized to other circuit topologies.
Robustness was evaluated using 300 specified tolerance-perturbed SPICE runs.
SHAP explains the surrogate model. SHAP importance should not be directly equated with a physical sensitivity coefficient.
